paragraphs: OverDrive distributes digital content to libraries and schools, with a catalog of ebooks, audiobooks and other digital media. Formats offered to library and school customers include ebooks, audiobooks, magazines and streaming video reaching beyond an organization's physical walls. School use runs from interactive Read-Along ebooks for a kindergartner to digital class sets for ELA for middle and high schoolers to career and test prep for college hopefuls.

Readers borrow ebooks, audiobooks and magazines from their library through the Libby app. A separate line of the business serves publishers, managing, protecting, fulfilling and promoting their ebooks and audiobooks. A company profile page puts the base served at more than 92,000 public libraries, K-12 schools, colleges and universities, and corporations in 115 countries.
The same page dates the founding to 1986 and describes a move from digitizing law books to distributing ebooks on floppy diskettes. That page also states that OverDrive is a Certified B Corporation.
